title: Settings page
description: A 1.0 settings page on Page layout="reading" (centred max 1536px inside 16px card padding, 64px bottom) with section tabs (Pills today; PillTabs once T5 merges) and one save action per section. Copy it with `semi add settings-page`.
a11y: Each section is a labelled ItemGroup; fields use Field (label, hint, error wired); the destructive action asks first (confirmDialog).
